newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen B index soars at noon, led by Wafangdian.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen B index soars at noon, led by Wafangdian.

text.p: Shenzhen's foreign currency B shares surged on Thursday morning, led by Wafangdian Bearing Co, partly as a reaction to strong rises on the Shanghai B share market, analysts said.
The index gained 8.07 points or 5.02 percent to 168.85.
Turnover was HK$94.4 million, surpassing the HK$89.4 million turnover registered for whole of Wednesday.
"Wafangdian and the bullish Shanghai market are injecting life into the Shenzhen B share market," a trader at China Southern Securities said.
Analysts said they expected the B index to hold in the afternoon given the heavy turnover.
"The index is unlikely to ease in the short term as sentiment is buoyant," the trader said.
Wafangdian was the star and the most actively traded stock. It rose HK$0.53 to its 10 percent limit-up of HK$5.83 on volume of 2.73 million shares.

Analysts said Wafangdian surged after the Shenzhen-based Securities Times on Thursday reported that its parent company, Wafangdian Bearing Group, would take over a high-technology company, Dalian Instrument Group.
A Wafangdian spokesman said the takeover would have no direct impact on the listed firm.
The Shanghai B share market, which traders said boosted sentiment in Shenzhen, ended the morning session at 79.543, up 2.673 points or 3.83 percent after scoring year highs on Tuesday and Wednesday.
Shenzhen's A share index added 0.46 points or 0.10 percent to 461.73 on turnover of 3.79 billion yuan.
Shenzhen Development Bank was the most actively traded stock on the A share market, gaining 0.99 yuan to 28.89 yuan on volume of 19.62 million shares.
